baseSelection.selectionReason: The stage evidence explicitly approves this exact predecessor head; it contains the planning commit and O00, and its own exact-head Lane CI is successful. Current origin/main does not contain O23-ID07.

implementation.accountEntry: History remains reachable with both rewards capabilities OFF; failed refreshes retain prior coin values and config with an error.
implementation.walletReads: Balance, history, and config use explicit required-read states. Initial failure does not display a zero balance or empty history; failed refresh keeps prior data and offers retry.
implementation.noticeStorage: Denomination notice storage is an independent optional state; its read/write errors do not replace successful wallet data.
implementation.emptyHistory: The empty state only mentions eligible completed bookings when earning is explicitly enabled; paused earning does not promise new rewards.
implementation.ledgerPresentation: Retains all six existing ledger kinds, signed paise values, dates, expiry, reasons, denomination conversion, and Seva Coins non-cash/non-transferable wording.
implementation.moneyBehavior: No calculation, API, authorization, RLS, refund/clawback, feature-flag, SQL function/object, or migration changes.

selectedCases: ID-COIN-LOAD-ERROR does not render a failed first read as zero or empty history
ID-COIN-LOAD-ERROR keeps prior balance and rows visible with a refresh error
ID-COIN-NOTICE-OPTIONAL keeps wallet and history when notice reads and writes fail
ID-COIN-BOTH-OFF keeps positive and negative history readable
ID-COIN-PAUSED-EMPTY treats zero and empty as loaded without encouraging earning
ID-COIN-DELTA-PRESERVE retains all ledger kinds, signs, dates, reasons and non-cash copy
shows eligible completed-booking copy for an enabled earning policy and a loaded-empty wallet
uses the owner-approved 1% policy and rounds to 10-paise coins
caps and rounds redemption by configured denomination, service value, platform revenue and balance
uses server eligibility and preserves legacy applied coins in previews
applies the configured per-booking cap, first-booking bonus, monthly cap and budget

moneyReview.reviewer: Direct focused review by the continuation agent.
checks: Balance, history and config errors propagate to the wallet state; failed initial reads do not render a zero balance or empty history.
Failed refresh retains the last wallet values and reports an error; notice-storage read/write failures are isolated from wallet data.
Both capability flags OFF preserve the history entry and existing ledger rows without promising new rewards.
All six ledger kinds, signed paise values, dates, expiry, reasons and non-cash/non-transferable wording remain present.
moneyReview.scope: Presentation and stale-read handling only; coin calculation helpers/tests, API/RPC, authorization, RLS, ledger rules, refund/clawback, flags, and migrations unchanged.
